mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year indicates inflationary pressure, which typically leads to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of the instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tight labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and subsequently higher interest rates, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of the instances when UNRATE < 4%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in housing starts (HOUST) indicates a weakening demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of the instances when HOUST declines.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a strengthening economy, which can lead to higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of the instances when INDPRO increases.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is below 2%, it suggests a potential monetary policy misalignment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of the instances when FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL < 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) suggests strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of the instances when PAYEMS increases > 200k and UNRATE decreases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real final sales (RSAFS) indicates weakening consumer demand, which can lead to a slowdown in economic growth and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of the instances when RSAFS decreases > 1%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in GDP (GDPC1) combined with a decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) suggests a mismatch in economic growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of the instances when GDPC1 increases and INDPRO decreases.
